test_cases.name: adapt_existing_app
test_cases.input: Review this SwiftUI view and adapt it for iPhone Duo. It currently uses fixed frames and bottom toolbar.
assertions: Suggests system toolbar for automatic vertical placement
Mentions safe area insets and fold avoidance

test_cases.name: split_view_recommendation
test_cases.input: My mail-style app needs to show list and detail on the big inner screen but single pane when closed. How should I structure it?
assertions: Notes automatic collapse on compact / outer display

test_cases.name: fold_handling
test_cases.input: Buttons keep landing in the center curve when the Duo is partially folded. What's the right way to fix this?
assertions: Points to Reserved Region API or system components
Explains interactive elements should avoid fold while scrollable content need not

test_cases.name: outer_display_controls
test_cases.input: On the closed Duo the screen is shorter. Where should my tab bar and nav buttons go?
assertions: Controls move to the side to maximize vertical space
System handles this with standard components
